summary.text: Melissa Maertens is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 10A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Mark Striemer in a race with no incumbent.
A small business owner, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her priorities are rural economic growth, public education and rural health care.

paragraphs.text: Melissa Maertens advanced from the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a small business owner with strong ties throughout central and northern Minnesota who has lived in the district for the past several years.
She said she has also worked extensively in animal rescue and advocacy, partnering with shelters and rescue organizations.

Maertens named three "Foundation Issues" in the survey: economic growth that supports working families, small businesses and rural communities, including broadband access; full funding for rural schools and action on teacher shortages; and access to health care, including rural hospitals and clinics, mental health care and telehealth.
